org: Livi-Pro — conversational AI for clinics · CTO / Head of R&D, full technical ownership (one senior engineer reporting)
title: Health­care
tagline: Clinics lose patients in messenger chats: slow replies, no night coverage, no trace of what was promised.

blocks.label: What I saw
blocks.text: A patient dialogue is a state machine that speaks natural language. Booking is structured data collection; empathy is how that process looks to the patient. Separate the two and quality becomes something you can test instead of eyeball.

blocks.label: What I built
blocks.text: In five months I took the platform from an empty repository to production with a live clinic. It has deterministic dialogue orchestration, an LLM, RAG over clinic knowledge, a booking state machine and operator handoff. Separately I built a behavioural regression rig: simulated patients talk to the bot and a calibrated LLM judge scores the behaviour they produce (5,300+ automated tests, judge on a local GPU at zero cloud cost). The cost of every model call is visible end to end.

blocks.label: Result
blocks.text: Clinics run in production, real patients book through the bot, and dialogue behaviour is tested systematically before a release. The unit economics of the product are modelled for investor negotiations.

blocks.label: Stack
blocks.text: async Python, PostgreSQL, RAG over a clinic knowledge base, Kubernetes, Prometheus · Grafana · Loki, local GPU inference for the judge
